<function=python>

# Press SPACE to switch to orange X

# Check orange X center

print(f"Orange X pixels: {len(o_x_pixels)}")

# Find center of orange X

    rows = [p[0] for p in o_x_pixels]
    cols = [p[1] for p in o_x_pixels]
    center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2

# Now move orange X to (48, 18)

dr = 48 - current_center[0]

print(f"Delta: ({dr}, {dc})")
steps_r = dr // 3
steps_c = dc // 3
print(f"Steps: {steps_r} vertical, {steps_c} horizontal")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
